title: Report on the exercise of relevant sub-delegated powers for the financial year ending 28 February 2026
summary: The Bank of England has published its annual report on the exercise of sub-delegated powers as the UK resolution authority, covering the financial year ending 28 February 2026. During the reporting period, two Technical Standards Instruments were made: one revoking EU-derived Simplified Obligations standards (effective 10 April 2025) and another partially revoking COREP13 resolution reporting templates (effective 27 January 2026).
key_points: Report is required under paragraph 32(2)(a) of Schedule 7 to the European Union (Withdrawal) Act 2018
Bank of England acted in its capacity as the UK resolution authority when exercising these powers
First instrument (10 April 2025) revoked Technical Standard 2019/348 on Simplified Obligations
Second instrument (27 January 2026) partially revoked Technical Standard 2018/1624 on resolution reporting by deleting six templates
Both instruments were made under s138P of the Financial Services and Markets Act 2000
why_it_matters: This report documents administrative changes to resolution reporting standards as part of post-Brexit regulatory alignment. It has no direct implications for market participants, monetary policy, or financial market structure. The changes are technical in nature and affect internal bank reporting requirements rather than market-facing operations.
